bibl.title: Dionysia's Complaint: Finding Emotions in the Courtroom.
bibl.seg: Ari Z. Bryen, Dionysia's Complaint: Finding Emotions in the Courtroom.
bibl.note: P. Oxy. II, 237, a lengthy proceeding between Dionysia and her father Chairemon, shows a decisive emotional tactic used in court, the "silencing" of the defendant in the face of the plaintiff’s accusations.
